items.requirement: Under concurrent authorized reserves against the same SKU, available stock never goes negative; when only one unit remains, at most one concurrent reserve creates a soft-hold. Race losers fail with the same named InsufficientStockError as sequential insufficient stock.
items.rationale: Soft-hold safety under interleaving is the demand; last-unit exclusivity and non-negative available stock must be machine-checkable, not only sequential.
items.threshold: No interleaving yields negative available stock; with availableStock=1, at most one concurrent reserve succeeds with a hold; other concurrent authorized losers return InsufficientStockError with no extra hold created.
items.measurement: OpenAPI + UML OCL + Vitest for sequential/checkable channels; bounded TLA+/TLC model under formal/ for the interleaving property.

items.requirement: Concurrent authorized reserves continue opaque-principal authorize/deny only (POL-OPAQUE-PRINCIPAL-AUTHZ). Unauthorized callers fail with named UnauthorizedError (or equivalent) and must not mutate stock or holds.
items.rationale: Concurrency must not weaken AuthZ; full IAM remains out of scope.
items.threshold: Unauthorized reserve always fails with UnauthorizedError and never mutates; authorized opaque principal may reserve subject to stock/concurrency rules.
items.measurement: Contract tests + OpenAPI UnauthorizedError channel; OCL preconditions on reserve; cite POL-OPAQUE-PRINCIPAL-AUTHZ.

items.requirement: N/A — no latency or throughput targets for this evaluation sample.
items.rationale: Concurrency safety is a correctness property, not an SLI/SLO ask for this sample.

items.requirement: Concurrent last-unit / non-negative stock safety is checkable via OpenAPI, UML OCL → Vitest, and a bounded TLA+/TLC model under formal/; do not rely on opaque internals alone.
items.rationale: solid_sdd Phase 3 formal path elevates interleaving beyond sequential DbC; host TLC toolchain exists at solid_sdd tools/tla/.
items.threshold: openapi/openapi.yaml documents InsufficientStockError (and UnauthorizedError) on reserve; contracts/**/*.ocl + tests/contracts/** cover insufficient-stock / race-loser naming; formal/**/*.tla (+ .cfg) model last-unit exclusivity and non-negative available stock with TLC-checkable bounds.
items.measurement: Presence of OpenAPI + OCL + passing Vitest; TLC run via solid_sdd tools/tla/tlc.sh (or documented equivalent) against formal/ for the bounded model.

items.requirement: Additive, non-breaking: keep prior reserve/release/expire/lookup HTTP and OCL surfaces; reuse named InsufficientStockError for race losers (same as sequential insufficient stock); do not remove or rename existing success/error channels.
items.rationale: Follow-on change; prior clients and Features must remain valid.
items.threshold: openapi/openapi.yaml remains structurally valid; prior operations and named errors remain; concurrency safety strengthens invariants without breaking additive API shape.
items.measurement: solidsdd-verify OpenAPI lint (or skip with tooling reason); review prior paths and InsufficientStockError reuse; prior Features stay in force.

items.requirement: UML OCL under contracts/**/*.ocl remains DbC SoT with Vitest under tests/contracts/**; introduce formal/ with bounded TLA+ (+ .cfg) as the concurrency SoT checked by TLC—not Alloy or other formal languages.
items.rationale: Matches solid_sdd adapter policy, inherited contract/test layout, and user-settled TLA+/TLC-only formal path.
items.threshold: contracts/**/*.ocl + derived Vitest cover sequential/checkable InsufficientStockError; formal/** holds a bounded TLA+/TLC model for interleaving; no Alloy/other formal SoT introduced.
items.measurement: Inspect contracts/, tests/contracts/, and formal/; regenerate Vitest via solidsdd-derive-tests when OCL changes; TLC against formal/ cfg.
